test_case.test_name: AMD OOB SDMA uncorrectable CPER validation
test_case.purpose: Prove one approved SDMA uncorrectable event creates a uniquely attributable CPER with exact SDMA/ext59/fatal decoding.
required_package: Secure Systems/UBB endpoint, CA/auth and CPER schema
Dedicated idle GPU SUT and GPU/BMC/host OOB recovery
test_case.test_command: Qualified operator captures complete CPER/health baseline, validates mappings/endpoint, runs `amdgpuras -d 0 -b 1 -s 0 -t 4` once, selects the unique new entry, downloads/hash-verifies and decodes it, validates OAM/SDMA/ext59/GFX_IP_Fatal_Error/fatal fields, then verifies platform recovery.
test_case.expected_result: Exactly one attributable new CPER identifies the intended OAM and SDMA bank with ext59 GFX_IP_Fatal_Error and uncorrected-system-fatal severity; GPU/BMC/host recover healthy.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact target/tool/endpoint identity, one injection, unique artifact, exact SDMA fields and recovery. Ambiguous record, GC/MMHUB bank, wrong code/severity, missing attachment or instability fails/blocks.
safety_gate: Critical error authorization on dedicated idle GPU SUT.
Do not infer block mapping or accept malformed/insecure endpoint.
Preserve complete entry baseline and use entry diff, not max index alone.
One injection only; no automatic retry/reset.
expected_evidence: Complete CPER baseline and single injection transcript
Unique entry diff and attachment hashes
Analyzer JSON with exact SDMA/ext59/type/severity fields
test_case.recovery: On wrong GPU, fatal hang or lost connectivity, preserve BMC evidence and use only approved OOB recovery; never inject/reset automatically and verify every accelerator before closure.
